US Suspends Green Card Program for Indian IT Firms

US authorities have suspended the green card program for several Indian IT firms, including Infosys, Tata, and Wipro. This action serves as a warning to the Indian IT industry regarding potential wider curbs, according to GTRI. The suspension impacts the firms' ability to secure permanent residency for their employees in the United States.
